wholeStoryVerdict: Materially more cohesive than PR118 and PR123. One kitchen, food subject, light and forward editorial progression replace website-modal/source-strip interruptions. Dinner 4-to-6 provides context; first tray in oven and second waiting can communicate a batch plan with restrained now/next leaders. The specific recipe CTA stays in the same setting. This is a real structural improvement rather than font polish.

blockingIssue.finding: The lower rim is visibly separated from counter and moves without visible support. The crop has not established plausible offscreen handling. Keeping the unsupported rim exposed defeats physical credibility.

otherWeaknesses: The 3x macro looks soft at 390px. Native source 720px and the preview 540px constrain this; a higher output raster alone cannot restore missing source detail.

Muted app intelligence is subtler than the known narration script: the viewer sees a dinner brief, batch plan and RecipeFix attribution, but not an explicit app operation. This is a tradeoff of removing UI, not a newly fabricated claim.
The ending remains quiet camera drift rather than a completed meal; no cooked or tasted payoff should be claimed.
oneFiniteCorrection: End the texture bridge before the lower rim appears: inspected 4.6-second frame still fills the phone with food/foil. Explicitly jump to the settled oven state and relocate the tray-contact cue to the cut if used. Do not prolong the exposed source movement solely to retain a 6.5-second effect marker, and do not begin another tracking-crop loop. This is honest editorial omission of loading, not proof of a continuous supported load.
stopCondition: If that finite explicit state cut still fails the complete sequence, the missing asset is believable supported loading/batching action in the same world. Do not certify premium or spend on a new shot without a separate bounded decision.
sensoryLimits: Complete actual playback was muted. No judgment of voice naturalness, intelligibility, music taste, foley realism, synchronization heard or subjective sound quality. Effect marker and script discussion are source/timing observations, not hearing.
nextGate: Actual corrected whole sequence, then exact final 360/390 playback only if the story and physics hold.
